Area.evidence_source: ["Participants shared similar maladaptive ways of coping with their loss of control such as alcohol use, which commonly resulted in negative outcomes and added to their already chaotic and adverse situations (Box 3).", "Participants referred to losing control of their life situation prior to their suicide attempt, and often described this in relation to the probation process.", "However, some participants were able to identify particular aspects of their lives that they were able to regain control over. For example, Josh acknowledges that he had lost control over his self-harm, but was able to regain control due to a 'thinking skills' programme run by Probation."]
